purpose: Measure the rank-one O(1) edge-sign cocycle, its first Stiefel-Whitney class on admitted dense-local graphs, resampling stability, arithmetic-precision stability, and composite-loop algebra.
why_retrospective: The prior dense analysis already revealed every elementary geometry-validation loop sign as +1, so composite signs are algebraically implied. This protocol may validate implementation, stability, and exact loop-space accounting but may not present the derived composite outcome as new out-of-sample evidence.
claim_boundary: This reanalysis may identify and validate a first Stiefel-Whitney class on the already-certified rank-one dense-local graphs. It cannot establish semantic identity, a natural-feature result, causal edit value, VPD efficacy, capability preservation, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI; it does not reopen any closed downstream stage.

retrospective_vpd_comparator.allowed_claim: Retrospective split-half determinant-sign stability only. No natural-feature label, line-bundle classification, or composite-loop prediction is allowed without a bound cycle basis.

object.site_admission: Consume only rank-one graph records whose prior bifiltration has beta_1 > 0; elementary generator availability is inherited exactly from its admitted_loop_ids.
object.edge_transport: sign of the rank-one frame overlap; overlaps with absolute value <= 1e-8 are invalid
object.loop_sign: product of O(1) edge transports around the registered oriented loop
object.classification: On each admitted graph, loop signs define w1 in H^1(graph; Z/2). w1=0 iff every cycle-basis sign is +1; for a real line bundle on a graph this is the complete isomorphism invariant.

derived_composite_checks.constraint_dependence: Do not use an iid binomial test over loops. Compute the GF(2) rank of the registered composite constraint rows per site and sum ranks across independent site graphs.
derived_composite_checks.descriptive_exact_null: If every point prediction hits, report 2^(-total_constraint_rank) under a uniform cohomology-class null. Label this descriptive because the elementary target signs were already revealed.

resampling.observed: independent within-class row bootstraps for every node and half
resampling.permutation_null: independent within-node label permutations preserving label counts; estimate rather than assume its agreement rate
resampling.derived_diagnostic_rule: For every composite: observed prediction lower bound, construction-generator reproducibility lower bound, and validation-loop reproducibility lower bound must each be >= 0.95; observed prediction lower bound must exceed the permutation-null upper bound by > 0.02.

precision.required: all point loop signs agree between arithmetic paths
precision.prohibited_claim: Do not call the result runtime-precision-stable. A separate full-precision model capture is required for that claim.

consumer_rules.certification_effect: none; this retrospective diagnostic does not upgrade an existing certificate
